name: Fire Party
label: Dischord
lede: Four friends started Fire Party in a D.C. basement in 1986, made two EPs for Dischord, and spent three months in Europe opening for Scream, where Dave Grohl was the drummer. At home people kept calling them an all-girl band. They kept asking to be judged on the songs.

eras.title: Basement practice, one fireplace night
eras.text: Dischord says D.C.'s underground had dozens of bands by the late 1980s and only a handful of women in them. Fire Party grew out of the circle around Revolution Summer, a name one of its own members had helped coin.

years.p: The phrase starts as an inside joke at a D.C. summer-jobs office, where Pickering, who also worked at Dischord, and Thomson were on the clock. It ends up naming a whole season of D.C. bands.

q: It was a fire party and it solidified our bonds.
years.h: Fire Party forms in Natalie Avery's parents' basement
years.p: [[Amy Pickering|7898585a-f3dd-4ca3-bd20-777eaef63764]] sings, Natalie Avery plays guitar, Kate Samworth bass and [[Nicky Thomas|4fcca973-445f-41c3-952b-df7fa008777f]] drums. The name comes from a night the four stayed up talking and laughing by a fireplace.
years.xp:
Avery worked at Yesterday and Today Records, and Thomas and Samworth worked at Olsson's Books and Records. Pickering, Avery and Samworth already knew each other, part of a tight group shaped by a very small music scene, as Avery has put it.

Thomas had played in Lebensluste and In Pieces. She came to drums almost by accident, after junior-high band on flute, bassoon and percussion.

The basement was Avery's parents'. The fireplace was where the name came from.

eras.title: Dedicated to Toni
eras.text: Fire Party played its first show for a friend who had just died, then turned up seven months later on the bill of the first Fugazi show ever.

yt: Fire Party live at d.c. space, 1987
years.h: Fire Party plays its first show, for Toni Young
years.p: At d.c. space, the band dedicates its debut set to Toni Young, bassist in Red C and later Dove, who Dischord says had recently died of pneumonia.
years.xp: Dischord's Red C history says a second Red C demo may have existed, but the tapes disappeared after Toni Young died.

years.h: Seven months on, Fire Party is on the bill when Fugazi debuts
years.p: The Wilson Center show is a $5 benefit for Dischord's State of the Union compilation. Also on the bill: [[Marginal Man|fff14e91-ae03-4105-8fbb-3a318d6c01ca]], Ignition and a brand-new band called [[Fugazi|233fc3f3-6de2-465c-985e-e721dbabbace]].

eras.title: Two EPs, a European run, then done
eras.text: Two records with Ian MacKaye at Inner Ear, and a long European run with Scream that Nicky Thomas says made her a different drummer. At home the band kept getting sold as a novelty. Dischord says European crowds listened to the songs.

years.h: Fire Party comes out as Dischord No. 28
years.p: The first 12-inch is recorded at Inner Ear and produced by [[Ian MacKaye|c12f644b-1066-4ead-b0dd-d0c380f5cca2]]. Jerk opens it, Basis follows.

years.big: really hated being thought of as an 'all-girl band'
yt: Fire Party live at d.c. space, 1988
years.h: Nicky Thomas on the label Fire Party couldn't shake
years.p: Thomas told No Echo the band always resisted the role. Dischord says audiences in the States kept getting distracted by the lineup.
years.xp:
Thomas said they "downplayed that" as much as they could. Dischord's history says the band wanted its work to stand on its own.

Europe went differently. Dischord says audiences there seemed more interested in the music being played than in who was playing it.

years.h: State of the Union finally ships, with Fire Party on it
years.p: The benefit compilation that paid for the night Fugazi debuted comes out in April 1989, and Fire Party is on the track list.

years.cap: Amy Pickering with a gourd shaker at Crash Club, Freiburg, Germany, 1988
years.src: Dischord · No Echo · Wikipedia: Fire Party
years.h: Fire Party spends three months on the road with Scream
years.p: [[Scream|b9f52132-28af-4cea-9558-165cd125f9b7]]'s drummer on the European run is a young [[Dave Grohl|4d5f891d-9bce-45ae-ad86-912dd27252fa]]. [[Nicky Thomas|4fcca973-445f-41c3-952b-df7fa008777f]] watches him every night.
years.xp:
Thomas told No Echo: "I was a completely different drummer after watching Dave Grohl for 3 months! He was my first and only drum teacher!"

She also said going over with their "big brothers" in Scream the first time gave the band a boost over there. Wikipedia adds that Fire Party supported That Petrol Emotion on the trip and played Midwest shows with Scream.

years.h: A John Peel Session in London, recorded mid-tour
years.p: The BBC Radio 1 session yields Basis, Are You On?, How To and Stray Bullet.

yt: Fire Party, New Orleans Opera full EP (1989)
years.h: New Orleans Opera, the second EP, is Dischord No. 37
years.p: Back at Inner Ear, this time with [[Ian MacKaye|c12f644b-1066-4ead-b0dd-d0c380f5cca2]] and [[Ted Niceley|fbe203ef-a327-4d7e-af16-a10d55b7347d]] producing. It carries Pilate, Gethsemane, Only Nine Mottos and the title track.

years.cap: Amy Pickering singing at 924 Gilman Street, Berkeley, 1989
years.h: After three or four years, Fire Party stops
years.p: Dischord puts the end in spring 1990. Nicky Thomas told No Echo it wasn't a fight, the members were changing and growing up.
years.xp:
Thomas's words to No Echo: "I think mostly we were simply changing and growing up."

Dischord dates the band Fall 1986 to Spring 1990.

eras.title: Nineteen songs, and what came after
eras.text: Dischord put both EPs and the John Peel Session on one CD, 19 Songs. The members went on to art, writing and other bands.

years.h: 19 Songs puts everything on one disc
years.p: Dischord No. 103 collects Fire Party, New Orleans Opera and the 1989 John Peel Session. The Peel take of Basis sits next to the original.

years.h: Kate Samworth turns to art, Nicky Thomas keeps drumming
years.p: Thomas plays with Hard Left and is writing a memoir about being Black and punk in America. Thomas calls Samworth "an incredible artist."
years.xp: Thomas told No Echo the memoir covers her time in Fire Party and growing up Black and punk in America. She also said she always has a project going with her friend Meghan Adkins.

years.h: Fire Party makes the 20 Years of Dischord box set
years.p: The label's 2002 anniversary collection includes the band.

sources.title: No Echo: Past Forward #2, Fire Party
